title: Isolate MODERATE delta-bar-delta under-relaxation
method: Replay the same in-place prepared-solve exact-tangent reanchor sequence. Keep MODERATE complexity and all explicitly set closure/iteration parameters fixed; in the second variant only disable nonlinear under-relaxation.
causal_test: If MODERATE_NO_UR closes while MODERATE_DEFAULT reproduces the stall, delta-bar-delta history is directly implicated rather than the broader MODERATE solver configuration.
forbidden: do not infer that disabling under-relaxation is generally safe for real coupled problems
